features.name: l2_norm_all_features
features.description: L2 norm of all 41 features after z-score normalization using training-set mean and std, representing the overall magnitude of a sample in feature space
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures distance from origin in normalized feature space, helping KNN identify outliers and boundary samples

features.name: continuous_features_mahal_approx
features.description: Approximate Mahalanobis-like distance using key continuous features (V1, V2, V8, V12, V13, V15, V30, V31, V36, V37, V39) normalized by their standard deviations
features.expected_model_benefit: Scale-normalized distance metric for continuous features improves KNN neighborhood geometry by removing scale bias

features.name: count_features_l1_norm
features.description: L1 norm of count/integer features (V3-V7, V9-V11, V16, V23, V32-V35, V38, V40, V41) normalized by their standard deviations, capturing structural complexity
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized count feature distance helps KNN distinguish structurally similar vs dissimilar molecules

features.name: ratio_v1_v2
features.description: Ratio of V1 to V2, capturing relative scale between two key continuous descriptors
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio features create new dimensions in feature space that can improve KNN separation

features.name: v8_zscore
features.description: Z-score of V8 (molecular weight-like descriptor) relative to training mean and std
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardized V8 directly improves KNN distance calculations by removing scale effects from a high-variance feature

features.name: v30_log1p_zscore
features.description: Log-transformed and z-scored V30, which has high variance and right skew, to normalize its distribution for distance calculations
features.expected_model_benefit: Log normalization of skewed V30 improves KNN distance metric by reducing influence of extreme values

features.name: binary_feature_sum
features.description: Sum of binary indicator features (V19, V24, V25, V26, V29) representing presence/absence of specific structural properties
features.expected_model_benefit: Binary feature aggregation creates a discrete cluster indicator that groups samples with similar structural fingerprints

features.name: v17_v18_v22_similarity
features.description: Cosine-like similarity score among tightly-ranged ratio features V17, V18, V22 relative to their training means
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures joint deviation pattern in ratio descriptors, improving KNN neighborhood coherence for samples with similar ratio profiles

features.name: v13_v15_v39_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance in the subspace of V13, V15, V39 (log-scale molecular descriptors) from their training means
features.expected_model_benefit: Focused distance in log-scale descriptor subspace helps KNN identify samples with similar electronic/topological properties

features.name: high_count_feature_indicator
features.description: Indicator for samples with unusually high count features, defined as having V5+V7+V9+V11 exceeding 2 standard deviations above mean sum
features.expected_model_benefit: Binary cluster indicator separates structurally complex molecules, improving KNN boundary definition

features.name: molecular_complexity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of molecular structural complexity based on the combined count of heteroatom-related features (V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V9, V10, V11) relative to training distribution norms. Higher values indicate more complex molecular structures with more diverse atom types and bonds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic complexity score that groups structurally similar molecules together, improving KNN cluster coherence

features.name: v27_v28_v36_v37_subspace_dist
features.description: Normalized distance in the subspace of V27, V28, V36, V37 (connectivity and branching descriptors) from training means
features.expected_model_benefit: Focused distance metric in connectivity descriptor subspace improves KNN sensitivity to molecular topology differences
